0.1.name: programming_domain
0.1.description: High-level programming domain (e.g., Data_Processing for pandas/numpy operations)

2.0.name: query_intent
2.0.description: What the user wants to accomplish. Be SPECIFIC. Good: 'convert JSON string to Python dict', 'find all files matching pattern'. Bad: 'data processing', 'file operations' (too generic).

4.0.name: primary_operation
4.0.description: Main operation in 3-5 words. Be MAXIMALLY SPECIFIC. Good: 'parse CSV to DataFrame', 'regex match email addresses'. Bad: 'data processing', 'string operations' (too generic).

6.0.name: key_apis
6.0.description: Primary API/module used. Include module path. Examples: 'os.path.join', 'json.loads', 'pandas.read_csv', 're.findall'

10.0.name: data_types_used
10.0.description: Data types/structures used. Be specific about types. Examples: 'list[dict]', 'pandas.DataFrame', 'bytes', 'collections.Counter', 'nested dict with string keys', 'generator of tuples'

12.0.name: operation_verbs
12.0.description: Action verbs describing what the code does. Extract up to 3. Examples: 'read, parse, filter', 'sort, deduplicate', 'encode, compress, write'

18.0.name: secondary_apis
18.0.description: Additional APIs/modules used beyond the primary. Extract up to 3. Examples: 'collections.defaultdict', 'functools.partial', 'itertools.chain'

19.0.name: return_behavior
19.0.description: What the code returns or produces. Examples: 'filtered list', 'boolean indicating success', 'generator of matches', 'modified dict in-place', 'None (side effect only)'

24.0.name: algorithm_pattern
24.0.description: Algorithm or pattern used. Be specific about the approach. Examples: 'recursive tree traversal', 'sliding window with dict', 'list comprehension with filter', 'context manager for file'

30.0.name: input_output_signature
30.0.description: Function signature style: input types -> output type. Examples: 'str -> list[str]', 'list[dict], str -> DataFrame', 'file_path: str -> bytes', '**kwargs -> None'

40.0.name: dependencies
40.0.description: External dependencies required. 'stdlib' if standard library only. Examples: 'numpy, pandas', 'requests', 'stdlib', 'PIL, numpy'

50.0.name: specific_task
50.0.description: Specific task in 5-10 words. Most discriminating field. Good: 'flatten nested dictionary preserving leaf keys'. Bad: 'process dictionary' (too generic).

70.0.name: code_signature
70.0.description: Key code pattern or function signature. Examples: 'def func(d, prefix=""): yield from ...', 'lambda x: x.get("key", default)', '[x for x in items if cond]'
